{{recipe}}

'''Soup alla Nazionale''' is a patriotic Italian [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]].

{{decameron}}

==Ingredients==
*Savoury [[Cookbook:custard|custard]]
*[[Cookbook:Spinach|Spinach]]
*[[Cookbook:Tomato|Tomatoes]]
*[[Cookbook:Broth|Broth]]

==Procedure==
#Make a savoury custard and divide it into three parts. Leave one white, color one red with tomato, and color the last one green with spinach.
#Put a layer of each colored custard in a buttered [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and cook for about 10 minutes until solidified.
#Cut the solidified custards into [[Cookbook:Dice|dice]].
#Put the colored custard pieces into a soup tureen and pour broth over top.
